tokenize_python_code: tokenize a Python source code string into a list of tokens using PythonProcessor
detokenize_python_code: detokenize a list of Python tokens back into formatted source code using PythonProcessor
obfuscate_python_code: obfuscate Python source code variable and function names using PythonProcessor
extract_functions_from_python: extract standalone and class methods from tokenized Python code using PythonProcessor
format_python_code_with_black: format and normalize Python source code using the apply_black function
